opening.argument: The speakers promote OneCoin through a network-marketing structure, describing the method as “bring one coin in a network marketing concept” and treating attendees as the system that drives its expansion. They tell participants that “the more we are, the more valuable the product becomes,” presenting growing membership as a mechanism for creating value. They also encourage customers to “start mining their coins and position themselves for a massive profit,” while predicting substantial growth from broader participation. Together, these claims pitch recruitment and mining as a route to increasing value and profit. The supplied material does not establish an individual loss or completed payout.
